summary: Iteration 4 validated new rental lifecycle (Requested->Assigned->In Use->Completed) with role guards + tracking, SOS endpoints (ride + delivery) with participant-only ACL and admin-only listing, driver_rating enrichment on Accept, plus regression on rides/deliveries/auth/admin stats. Backend pytest: 12/12 passed. Frontend: login-hint-card shows all 3 demo creds (informational, not clickable). Real login for user/driver/admin all lands on correct dashboards. Admin panel renders 6 stat cards (Users, Captains, Rides, Rentals, Deliveries, Revenue). Driver dashboard renders Earnings/Rating/Completed cards, Captain Speed broadcast with captain-gps-toggle-btn + captain-speed-slider, Incoming & Active section, and Rentals section. No runtime crashes observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin/stats aggregates rental revenue over statuses {Requested, Assigned, In Use, Completed} — this counts unfulfilled 'Requested' rentals into revenue (₹1279 in test env inflated by pending). Consider limiting to Completed only, or add a separate 'pending revenue' field.
SOS endpoints allow rider to raise before a driver is assigned — correct, but ensure admin listing includes context (currently only ref_id). Fine for MVP.
server.py is 864 lines — above 700 line threshold; recommend splitting into routes/models packages.
Driver 'Rating' card renders currentDriver profile rating (dynamic) — verified 5.0 for seed driver. Good.
Login page: three demo credentials are shown as text-only inside login-hint-card; there are no clickable demo buttons — matches requirement.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py (added test_rental_lifecycle, test_sos_ride, test_sos_delivery_and_admin_list; verified driver_rating enrichment on ride accept)
test_credentials: Rider user@ops.com/user123, Captain driver@ops.com/driver123, Admin admin@ops.com/admin123 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_driver2-<uuid>@example.com signup per module for lifecycle acceptance tests. Also TEST_user/TEST_driver via signup validation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py covers auth, ride+delivery+rental lifecycles/tracking/fares, SOS (both types + admin listing), and admin stats. Rerun: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_ops_api.py -v. Note: admin total_revenue currently includes Requested/Assigned/In Use rentals (not just Completed); test assertion is >=95 so remains stable. If rental revenue logic changes, tighten assertion.
rca of the issue: No blockers found this iteration. Earlier during frontend body-text check, 'Deliveries' and 'Revenue' appeared missing — root cause was Tailwind text-transform:uppercase on stat labels, so inner_text() returned uppercase forms (DELIVERIES/REVENUE). Screenshot confirmed all 6 cards render. No code change needed.
